name: norush-operations
description: Open-source remote tank gauging: total level and oil/water interface for flowback and production tanks

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=edge
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB "npm run start:dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace=backend && concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB "npm run start:prod --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres mqtt rabbitmq redis
